adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete action at line 42-48 shows: `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { this.sendAction('deleteHost', this.get('host')); });` - there is no .catch() handler for the destroyRecord() promise. Compare this to the save() action which properly has `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the DELETE request fails, the promise rejection will be unhandled and the admin won't see any error message. This is a real bug where error handling is inconsistent within the same component.
